methodology: To perform the analysis, I systematically decomposed the provided information into atomic units by identifying distinct requirements, features, and constraints. Each unit was defined to be independent, specific, and implementable.
mindtraced_atomic_units: Design a 12-hour clock with AM/PM indicator.
Counters increment based on a fast-running clock signal.
Reset initializes the clock to 12:00 AM.
Outputs include hh, mm, ss in BCD format.
Enable signal triggers increment once per second.
spec_atomic_units: Module implements a 12-hour clock with AM/PM indication.
Clock increments based on enable signal pulsing once per second.
Reset initializes clock to 12:00 AM with highest priority.
Outputs hh, mm, ss are in BCD format.
PM signal toggles at noon and midnight.
Sequential logic operates on rising edge of clk.
